_source: Art direction — 'slightly cartoon but detailed'. See design/10-art-direction.md.
pillars: Bold, readable silhouettes first — RTS units must be identifiable at 100% zoom-out
Clean dark outlines (2-3px equivalent) around major forms, thinner interior lines
Cel shading: 1 body tone + 1 shadow + 1 highlight, plus a soft occlusion pass
Detail lives in the surface, not the silhouette: panel lines, rivets, vents, wear
Slightly exaggerated proportions (chunky treads, oversized cannons, heavy feet)
Saturated faction 'team color' on ~20% of the unit; desaturated body for the rest
Grounded contact shadow under every unit for readability on any terrain

damageStates.critical: exposed metal, fire flicker, heavier smoke, sparks
